Ink of Flames.description: Boosts Fire damage and grants massive Fire damage boost after hitting monster weak points.
Ink of Flames.four_piece: After hitting a weak point, fire damage +24% for 20s.

Ink of Frost.description: Boosts Ice damage and surges Ice damage upon landing hits on monsters.
Ink of Frost.four_piece: After hitting a monster, ice damage +24% for 8s.

Ink of Thunder.description: Boosts Thunder damage with stacking Thunder damage buffs when dealing consecutive hits.
Ink of Thunder.four_piece: After dealing damage to monsters, thunder damage +5% for 12s, up to 5 stacks.

Ink of Water.description: Boosts Water damage and stacks additional Water damage each time squadmates unleash ultimates.
Ink of Water.four_piece: Each time a squadmate unleashes an ultimate, water damage +6% for 60s, up to 4 stacks.

Ink of Dragon.description: Boosts Dragon damage and grants a huge 24% Dragon damage spike after firing your ultimate.
Ink of Dragon.four_piece: After using an ultimate, dragon damage +24% for 60s.

Ink of Might.description: Boosts base Physical damage and grants sustained +12% Physical damage upon landing critical strikes.
Ink of Might.four_piece: After landing a critical hit, physical damage +12% for 60s.

Ink of Combat.description: Grants flat +5% Affinity and empowers the whole squad when an ultimate inflicts debuffs.
Ink of Combat.four_piece: When an ultimate inflicts a debuff on a monster, squad damage +6.5% for 60s.

Ink of Guidance.description: Accelerates Ultimate charge rate and stacks squad-wide damage amplification during monster suppression.
Ink of Guidance.four_piece: Within 8s after an ultimate inflicts suppression on a monster, each time the squad uses an ultimate, squad damage +2.2% for 60s, up to 3 stacks.

Ink of Protection.description: Accelerates Ultimate charge and amplifies heals/shields by +20% while bolstering squad damage.
Ink of Protection.four_piece: When an adventurer and Buddy grant a squadmate healing or shield effect, the effect +20%, squad damage +6% for 45s.

Ink of Grace.description: Accelerates Ultimate charge rate and grants squad-wide +6.5% damage bonus whenever granting a buff.
Ink of Grace.four_piece: When an adventurer grants a squadmate a buff, squad damage +6.5% for 60s.

Ink of Resonance.description: Grants +5% Affinity and a colossal +32% Ultimate damage when swapped off as non-Main Adventurer.
Ink of Resonance.four_piece: When not playing as the Main Adventurer, ultimate damage +32%.
